result:
These queries come from the documentation page alone and none were run. Three guesses in them are not on the page:

- **`round` (H2, H10):** the page lists no rounding verb, so I assumed one called `round` exists.
- **`groupBy` (H3, H7, H8, H10, H14):** I assumed it answers a map from key to the vector of its elements, with keyword keys.
- **`if (has :k)` (H6, H12, H13):** I assumed `has :k` tests whether a map has a key.

H14 splits on `;`, `.`, `,` and `!` in turn, because there is no regex or replace verb.

H1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(/country | lower | eq "de") | filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) | filter ~(/age | gte 30) | * /name | sort
H2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
H3: groupBy ~(/customer | lower | keyword) | * count
H4: {:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys | * keyword | sort)}
H5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | mul -1) /id]) | take 3 | * /id
H6: * (if (has :labels) ~(/labels) ~([])) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort
H7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~((if (at :assignee | eq null) ~("unassigned") ~(/assignee/login)) | keyword) | * count
H8: lines | filter ~(eq "" | not) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2 | keyword) | * count
H9: lines | filter ~(eq "" | not) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | :l / | #["ERROR" "WARN"] | contains l) | * (drop 3 | filter ~(startsWith "user=")) | flat | * (split "=" | /1) | distinct | sort
H10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(eq "" | not) | * (split ",") | filter ~(/4 | lower | eq "up") | filter ~(/2 | eq "" | not) | groupBy ~(/1 | keyword) | * (* (/2 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10)
H11: lines | filter ~(eq "" | not) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(upper | startsWith "DB_") | indexBy ~(split "=" | first | split "_" | drop 1 | join "_" | lower | keyword) | * (split "=" | drop 1 | join "=")
H12: :d /defaults/timeout | /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | sort ~/name | * {:name /name :timeout (if (at :timeout | type | eq ::number) ~(/timeout) ~(d)) :team (if (at :owner | type | eq ::map) ~(/owner | if (has :team) ~(/team) ~("none")) ~("none"))}
H13: /results | filter ~(at :score | type | eq ::number) | filter ~(/score | gte 50) | sort ~/score | reverse | * ([([/profile/first /profile/last] | join " ") (if (has :tags) ~(/tags | join "|") ~(""))] | join ": ")
H14: "The cat saw the dog; a Dog saw THE cat and a bird. Bird, dog!" | lower | split " " | * (split ";") | flat | * (split ".") | flat | * (split ",") | flat | * (split "!") | flat | filter ~(eq "" | not) | groupBy ~(keyword) | :g / | keys | * (:w / | {:word (w | keyword) :count (g | at w | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
